# Vanity Fair

> Entertainment, politics, celebrity, fashion, and culture news and commentary from Vanity Fair.

Vanity Fair covers Hollywood, television, movies, politics, style, royals, business, and cultural life through reported features, interviews, criticism, photography, video, newsletters, and special event coverage.

## Main Sections
- [Hollywood](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood): Entertainment reporting on movies, television, celebrities, awards, and the industry.
- [Style](https://www.vanityfair.com/style): Fashion, beauty, celebrity style, royals, and lifestyle coverage.
- [News](https://www.vanityfair.com/news): Reporting and commentary on politics, power, media, and current events.
- [Culture](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture): Arts, books, design, theater, and broader cultural criticism and features.
- [Business](https://www.vanityfair.com/news/business): Coverage of business, technology, media, and influential industries.
- [Hive](https://www.vanityfair.com/news/business): Vanity Fair’s business and media reporting hub.
- [Video](https://www.vanityfair.com/video): Original video interviews, explainers, celebrity features, and recurring series.
- [Podcasts](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast): Vanity Fair podcast shows and episode pages.

## Hollywood
- [Hollywood](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood): Main entertainment vertical for film, TV, celebrities, and awards coverage.
- [Movies](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/movies): Film news, reviews, interviews, trailers, and industry reporting.
- [Television](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/television): TV news, reviews, recaps, interviews, and streaming coverage.
- [Awards Insider](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/awards-insider): Awards-season reporting on Oscars, Emmys, festivals, and campaigns.
- [Oscars](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/oscars): Dedicated Academy Awards coverage, predictions, winners, and red carpet stories.
- [What Is Cinema?](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/what-is-cinema): Interview series exploring filmmaking craft with directors and creators.
- [HWD Daily](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/hwd-daily): Newsletter focused on Hollywood and entertainment industry news.

## Style
- [Style](https://www.vanityfair.com/style): Main style section for fashion, beauty, celebrity looks, and society coverage.
- [Fashion](https://www.vanityfair.com/style/fashion): Runway, designer, trend, and celebrity fashion reporting.
- [Beauty](https://www.vanityfair.com/style/beauty): Beauty trends, products, celebrity looks, and skincare coverage.
- [Royals](https://www.vanityfair.com/style/royals): Reporting on the British royal family and royal-adjacent news.
- [Shopping](https://www.vanityfair.com/style/shopping): Product recommendations and editor-curated shopping guides.
- [Vanities](https://www.vanityfair.com/style/vanities): Society, parties, personalities, and lifestyle features.
- [Style Newsletter](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/style): Newsletter featuring fashion, beauty, and style stories.

## News, Politics & Power
- [News](https://www.vanityfair.com/news): Main news desk covering politics, media, power, and investigations.
- [Politics](https://www.vanityfair.com/news/politics): U.S. politics, elections, campaigns, and Washington reporting.
- [Business](https://www.vanityfair.com/news/business): Business, tech, Wall Street, Silicon Valley, and media coverage.
- [The Hive](https://www.vanityfair.com/news/business): Analysis and reporting on business, politics, and media power centers.
- [Inside the Hive](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast/inside-the-hive): Podcast on politics, media, and business from Vanity Fair.
- [The Weekender](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/the-weekender): Newsletter highlighting major stories and weekend reading.
- [Politics Newsletter](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/politics): Newsletter centered on political news and commentary.

## Culture
- [Culture](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture): Main culture section for arts, books, ideas, and criticism.
- [Books](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/books): Author interviews, literary features, and book coverage.
- [Art](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/art): Reporting on artists, exhibitions, and the art world.
- [Theater](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/theater): Broadway and stage coverage, reviews, and profiles.
- [Music](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/music): Music features, artist interviews, and industry stories.
- [Travel](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/travel): Travel features, destination stories, and cultural itineraries.
- [Culture Newsletter](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters): Vanity Fair newsletters page including culture-focused subscriptions.

## Audio & Video
- [Video](https://www.vanityfair.com/video): Vanity Fair’s video hub with celebrity and editorial programming.
- [Podcasts](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast): Directory of Vanity Fair podcast shows and episodes.
- [Little Gold Men](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast/little-gold-men): Awards-season podcast covering Oscars races and entertainment contenders.
- [Inside the Hive](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast/inside-the-hive): Podcast on politics, media, and business power dynamics.
- [DYNASTY](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast/dynasty): Narrative podcast about famous families, legacies, and cultural dynasties.
- [Still Watching](https://www.vanityfair.com/podcast/still-watching): Television-focused podcast discussing major series and episodes.
- [Video Archive](https://www.vanityfair.com/video/series): Browse recurring Vanity Fair video series and franchises.

## Awards & Special Coverage
- [Awards Insider](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/awards-insider): Vanity Fair’s central hub for awards-season reporting and analysis.
- [Oscars](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/oscars): Academy Awards coverage including nominees, winners, and red carpet.
- [Award Season](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/award-season): Broader awards coverage spanning Oscars, Emmys, and festivals.
- [Oscar Party](https://www.vanityfair.com/oscar-party): Coverage of Vanity Fair’s annual Oscar Party and red carpet.
- [Cannes](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/cannes): Reporting from the Cannes Film Festival and premieres.
- [Emmys](https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/emmys): Emmy Awards coverage, predictions, and television awards reporting.

## Newsletters
- [Newsletters](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters): Central page for Vanity Fair email newsletters.
- [HWD Daily](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/hwd-daily): Daily newsletter covering Hollywood and entertainment industry news.
- [The Weekender](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/the-weekender): Weekend digest of major Vanity Fair stories and recommendations.
- [Style](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/style): Newsletter focused on fashion, beauty, and celebrity style.
- [Politics](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/politics): Newsletter featuring political reporting and analysis.
- [Royals Watch](https://www.vanityfair.com/newsletters/royals-watch): Newsletter dedicated to royal family coverage and commentary.
